identificationModule.briefTitle: Neoadjuvant mFOLFOX6 Chemotherapy Combined With Anti-PD-1 Therapy in MSS/pMMR Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer (FIRM02 Study)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized Controlled Clinical Study of Neoadjuvant mFOLFOX6 Chemotherapy Combined With Anti-PD-1 Therapy in MSS/pMMR Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer (FIRM02 Study)

leadSponsor.name: Xinhua Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This multicenter, randomized controlled clinical trial (FIRM02 Study) aims to evaluate the effectiveness and safety of neoadjuvant mFOLFOX6 chemotherapy combined with PD-1 inhibitor (Serplulimab) in patients with MSS/pMMR locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC). A total of 128 patients with non-metastatic, untreated, locally advanced rectal cancer will be randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to either the experimental group (64 patients) or the control group (64 patients). The experimental group will receive 6 cycles of mFOLFOX6 chemotherapy combined with 3 mg/kg of Serplulimab every 2 weeks prior to surgery. The control group will receive 6 cycles of mFOLFOX6 chemotherapy alone. The primary endpoint is the pathological complete response (pCR), and secondary endpoints include major pathological response (MPR), tumor regression grade (TRG), overall response rate (ORR), and survival outcomes (DFS, RFS, and OS). Safety will be assessed based on adverse events and post-operative complications.

armGroups.label: mFOLFOX6+Serplulimab
armGroups.description: Preoperative treatment with mFOLFOX6 chemotherapy combined with Serplulimab (3mg/kg) every 2 weeks, for a total of 6 cycles before surgery.

armGroups.label: mFOLFOX6
armGroups.description: Preoperative treatment with mFOLFOX6 chemotherapy every 2 weeks, for a total of 6 cycles before surgery.

interventions.name: mFOLFOX6
interventions.description: Oxaliplatin 85 mg/m², intravenous infusion on Day 1; Fluorouracil 400 mg/m², intravenous infusion on Day 1; Fluorouracil 2400 mg/m², continuous infusion via chemotherapy pump for 46-48 hours; Leucovorin calcium 400 mg/m², intravenous infusion on Day 1 (or Levoleucovorin 200 mg/m², intravenous infusion).

secondaryOutcomes.description: The Neoadjuvant Rectal Score (NAR) ranges from 0 to 100, with lower scores indicating better neoadjuvant efficacy.

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Adverse events are evaluated the day before each chemotherapy cycle, up to 90 days after the last neoadjuvant treatment.
